entities.name: Dew
entities.description: One of five legendary kirin kami of Kamigawa representing blue, who speaks in riddles and walks mortal dreams.

entities.name: Scale
entities.description: A kirin who questioned Dew and charged off after.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which the kirin met.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Place with a painting containing the teahouse.

entities.name: Meloku
entities.description: Young soratami whose dream palace Dew danced in.

entities.name: Ishi-Ishi
entities.description: Akki who found the persimmon tree of plenty.

entities.name: Snow Fur
entities.description: Kitsune who dreamt of Dew's breeze and wrote his first poem.

events.summary: As the Kami War begins, the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo.
events.quote: the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years

events.summary: Dew says he sees mortals as vessels and beings of light and wonder; the others call it madness.
events.quote: Dew responded that he speaks of dreams

events.summary: Dew recounts walking in mortals' dreams, including those of Meloku, Ishi-Ishi and Snow Fur.
Scale charges off and the kirin leave the meeting; Dew vanishes unnoticed.
events.quote: Dew disappeared without a word or the others noticing

relations.quote: one of the five legendary kirin kami from Kamigawa
